entries.title: leads.json truncated on origin/data by commit 015cf9d (research: L0093)
entries.detail: At 14:13:44 on 2026-11-13 commit 015cf9d (research: L0093, from a concurrent lead-scout session) rewrote data/leads.json with 7 insertions and 6608 deletions; the file now stops mid-record around line 19601 (a Stitch Product Manager lead, cut after "exp_min") and no longer parses. It is already on origin/data. The previous commit c9891c2 (research: L0092) parses fine. Likely cause: two processes (send-track and lead-scout/scout) wrote leads.json at the same moment while store.sync ran git reset --hard. Every lead command now fails with 'Expecting : delimiter'. Fix: restore leads.json from c9891c2 and re-apply the L0093 research, then add a file lock around store.transact so concurrent agents cannot interleave. send-track stopped writing to leads once this was found.

entries.title: leads.json corrupted on data branch by concurrent write (commit 015cf9d)
entries.detail: Commit 015cf9d 'research: L0093' (2026-11-13 14:13) truncated leads.json to invalid JSON (7 insertions, 6608 deletions; parse error line 19601 col 13). Cause: lead-scout ran 'outreach scout' in the background while running 'lead research' in the foreground; store.save() writes every process to the same leads.json.tmp path, so the two writes interleaved and transact() committed and pushed the mangled file. Last good commit: c9891c2. Fix: 'git -C data revert 015cf9d && git push origin HEAD:data' (my revert was blocked by the permission classifier), then re-run research for L0093-L0128 from the saved JSON in the run notes. Code fix: give save() a unique temp name (e.g. tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile in DATA_DIR) and validate JSON before commit; also a hung 'git fetch' from 13:17 (pid 62733, another session) and 'cannot lock ref' races when two CLI calls sync at once. Separately: 'lead research' auto-rejected L0090 (AiSteth) with 'score 64 is under 65' although decision was qualify.

entries.title: Diagnosis: GitHub scheduled workflows run hours late or are dropped

entries.title: git fetch of data branch hangs for hours
entries.detail: On 2026-11-14 several 'git -C data fetch origin data' calls (from store.sync) hung for 2+ hours with no timeout, while github.com answered normally.
